prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; not stocky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other — wearing a skin-tight glossy cherry-red PVC catsuit with long sleeves and matching PVC gloves, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the PVC fully covering her bust, stretched over every curve from neck to ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbows and knees, completely opaque, the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, and a seamless cherry-red PVC hood covering her whole head, face and neck with mirror shine, closed by a zipper at the back, with three openings cut in the PVC: two almond-shaped openings around her eyes, a small opening for her nose and one around her lips. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a thick straight round bar of aged brass with a green verdigris patina that spans the full width of the chamber from one stone wall to the other, both ends set deep into the stone blocks, at a height just above her raised hands, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her wrists a little wider apart than her shoulders and her arms raised straight up. Her left ankle wears heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, its ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb that runs up to the brass bar above her, pulling that leg up and forward with the knee bent, the chain pulled dead taut. Her right ankle wears heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, its ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to a huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor beside her standing foot. Pose: standing on her right leg, facing the camera, her left leg lifted forward and up with the knee bent by the chain, her arms raised straight up to the bar with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her head tipped slightly forward, her bare standing foot flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Wear: The suit is scuffed grey along her thighs, knees and elbows, dusted with soot and streaked with rust-brown stains from the iron at her wrists and ankles, sweat beads on the polish, and the gloves are blackened on the backs of her hands. Faint soot smudges circle the openings around her eyes, her lips are dry and a little cracked, and her bare feet and toes are black with grime.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy cherry-red PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy PVC hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a faintly defeated look, her eyes lowered and a little glassy, the corners of her mouth turned down just slightly, makeup: wet-look glass skin glowing as if coated in clear gel, strong liquid highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge and the center of the forehead, a flushed rosy blush, high-shine glossy lips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
